{{Quote|«It is an organization that oversees all forms of gambling in the galaxy. The legitimate ones, at least.»|PH4-LNX on G.A.M.E.|<ref name="Worthy Employer">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Worthy Employer|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>|quotestart=0|trans=1|quoteend=0}}
The '''Gambling Authority and Management Entity (G.A.M.E.)''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] in charge of overseeing all forms of legal [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] looking out for any signs of fraudalent behavior. The Gambling Authority and Management Entity was also known for sponsoring gambling tournaments.<ref name="Worthy Employer" />

Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates:7.0">{{TOR_updates|7.1}}</ref> G.A.M.E. was known to deploy [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] to apprehend any [[Gambler/Legends|gamblers]] caught cheating.<ref name="Cheating Algorithm">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Cheating Algorithm|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[PH4-LNX]], was employed by G.A.M.E before joining the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="Worthy Employer" />
